events.title: 서울대 행정학 교육에서 행정대학원 제도화로의 전환
events.finding: Jeong In-heung taught at SNU Law College through June 1959, authored an early Korean public-administration textbook, and is credited in scholarly biography with substantial efforts toward GSPA creation.
events.attribution_limit: Do not convert intellectual/institutional effort into formal decree proposal authorship without committee/ministry records.

events.title: 서울대 행정대학원 초기 교수·창설 네트워크
events.finding: Multiple early faculty actors can now be separated from the formal presidential-decree layer. KRIHS gives No Yung-hee an SNU GSPA professorship beginning August 1958, indicating pre-opening personnel/institution-building activity before Decree No. 1429's promulgation.
events.attribution_limit: The apparent 1958 start predating legal establishment is a chronology question, not an error to silently normalize. It may reflect predecessor-unit appointment or retrospective institutional dating and requires personnel-order verification.

events.title: 서울대 행정대학원 제1기 교육 실행
observed_by: Korea University biography of Paik Wan-ki
SNU emeritus memoir of Oh Seok-hong
events.finding: Paik Wan-ki's institutional biography records SNU GSPA master's completion in 1961 after 1959 SNU undergraduate graduation; Oh Seok-hong's first-person memoir states he participated as a student at GSPA's creation and became a first graduate.

events.title: 명주완 서울대 보건대학원 초대원장 재임 시작
observed_by: SNU Graduate School of Public Health official former-deans page
events.finding: SNU's official former-deans page dates first dean Myung Ju-wan's term 1959-04-01 to 1960-06-30, exactly matching Decree No. 1429's effective date.
events.attribution_limit: Date alignment supports implementation linkage but does not itself prove who nominated/appointed him or who originated the school proposal.

events.title: 제1429호 공포일·시행일·기관 설립일 표기 분리
events.finding: Institutional histories conventionally call 1959-01-13 the GSPA founding date, while the decree is effective 1959-04-01 and GSPH's first dean term starts 1959-04-01. Both dates must be retained with different semantics.
events.later_finding: No contradiction is forced: promulgation/founding convention and statutory implementation can legitimately use different dates.

events.title: 행정대학원 내 조사연구실 설치
executed_by: SNU Graduate School of Public Administration
observed_by: KCI institutional registry for Korea Institute of Public Affairs
events.finding: The institutional registry dates a research office inside GSPA to 1959, later expanded in 1967 into the Institute of Public Administration and renamed in 1990.

events.title: 서울대 보건대학원 예방의학 과정 개설
executed_by: Myung Ju-wan and SNU public-health faculty
observed_by: Korean Society for Preventive Medicine history
events.finding: Professional-society history records the 1959 preventive-medicine course at SNU Graduate School of Public Health and associates Myung Ju-wan with it.

events.title: 제1429호 공포 후 시행 전 인사·조직 이행 공백
events.finding: The legal instrument and implementation actors are now known in part, but the intermediate personnel/organization orders linking promulgation to April 1 operation remain missing.

cross_validation.result: promulgation/founding convention 1959-01-13 separated from legal/appointment implementation 1959-04-01
institution-building involved an academic network distinct from formal presidential promulgation; exact personnel orders remain open

sources: Korean Society for Preventive Medicine history
cross_validation.result: Myung is strongly established as implementation/founding actor; decree authorship remains unsupported
